changelog: 1.3.9: Prioritizes the live-proven exact-language AniKage MegaPlay route before Flow/Zuri; all twelve alternatives and existing route IDs remain available for manual selection.

2026-10-07 live Death Note E1 SUB (required captions) and DUB (runtime optional-caption gate) resolver/HLS inspections passed via anikage-megaplay:primary: 312 segments and one mapped caption each, under one second. No full transfer, caption-file validation or playback was performed.
The inspected MegaPlay candidate supplied no quality value; the existing primary route ID and Auto behavior remain unchanged.
1.3.8: Adds bounded response-selected public HTTPS caption origins (up to four per accepted route) and exact manual server-route resolution; module API origins remain fixed.
Fixture tests confirm src/file/url subtitle mapping and actual WebVTT cue fetch. Live native transfer, spoken audio identity and offline playback acceptance remain unverified.
1.3.7: Extends bounded read-only reuse to provider GETs within one resolution attempt; existing metadata-query reuse is unchanged.
0.1.0-experimental.2: Uses Host 10 bounded response-selected public HTTPS subtitle origins for changing MegaPlay caption hosts while preserving current MegaPlay Origin/Referer headers.

2026-10-07 live Death Note E1 SUB resolver/HLS inspection passed in 487 ms with 312 segments and one mapped caption track. This was a route inspection only; no current DUB live inspection, full transfer, caption-file fetch or physical playback was tested.
Fixture tests bind both requested SUB/DUB routes and reject identity mismatches; current DUB live behavior remains unverified.
0.1.0-experimental.1: Bounded data-only download definition; requires content host 6.
2026-10-02: A paced private workstation SUB transfer passed (271/271 TS segments; 199,625,544 bytes; 1,372.035-second playlist; H.264/AAC).
This is one workstation transfer only; spoken-language semantics, full DUB transfer, caption-file transfer and native phone/offline acceptance remain unverified.
1.0.1-experimental.1: Current .fun provider routes with preserved .vip saved references. Offline transfer remains blocked by separate audio and encryption.
1.0.0-experimental.1: Bounded data-only download definition; requires content host 6.
Canonical source paths and requests use streamingunity.fun; .vip remains only for legacy saved movie/episode reference aliases. Module IDs and identity are preserved.

Live Vix master and media-playlist requests returned HTTP 200, but external audio groups and AES-128-encrypted media segments are unsupported by the current download pipeline. No full transfer was attempted; native offline acceptance remains unverified.
0.1.0-experimental.1: Downloads data definition based on Player AnimeAV1 1.3.0-beta.4. Requires content host 9 / app 1.0.84.
Bounded search, details, numbered episode identity and MP4Upload SUB resolution; exact HTTPS media origin and port, no downloaded JavaScript execution.

One private workstation full MP4 transfer and decode passed. The sampled file used AV1 video with Spanish burnt-in captions; selectable subtitles, other audio variants, native phone playback and background acceptance remain unverified. Quality is source-unknown; choose Auto rather than assuming Data Saver can select a lower rendition.
